name: voice-to-text-desktop
description: Local Transcribe — local-first desktop audio/video transcription.

scripts.bundle:mac: cargo build --release -p voice-to-text-lan --bin local-transcribe-node && cargo build --release -p voice-to-text-cli -p voice-to-text-mcp -p voice-to-text-service && cp ../../target/release/local-transcribe-node src-tauri/binaries/local-transcribe-node-aarch64-apple-darwin && cp ../../target/release/local-transcribe src-tauri/binaries/local-transcribe-aarch64-apple-darwin && cp ../../target/release/voice-to-text-mcp src-tauri/binaries/voice-to-text-mcp-aarch64-apple-darwin && cp ../../target/release/voice-to-text-service src-tauri/binaries/voice-to-text-service-aarch64-apple-darwin && tauri build --bundles app --no-sign && for b in local-transcribe-node local-transcribe voice-to-text-mcp voice-to-text-service; do codesign --force --sign - --identifier net.timhuang.localtranscribe "../../target/release/bundle/macos/Local Transcribe.app/Contents/MacOS/$b"; done && codesign --force --sign - --identifier net.timhuang.localtranscribe "../../target/release/bundle/macos/Local Transcribe.app"
